months.name: Chaitra
months.description: Month 1 of the Hindu lunar year: the month in which the Sun enters sidereal Meṣa (Aries).
months.uncertainty: Counted here new Moon to new Moon (amānta, as in much of western and southern India). In the pūrṇimānta reckoning of northern India the month runs full Moon to full Moon, so its dark half has the previous month's name.

months.name: Vaishakha
months.description: Month 2 of the Hindu lunar year: the month in which the Sun enters sidereal Vṛṣabha (Taurus).
months.uncertainty: Counted here new Moon to new Moon (amānta, as in much of western and southern India). In the pūrṇimānta reckoning of northern India the month runs full Moon to full Moon, so its dark half has the previous month's name.

observances.name: Ugadi and Gudi Padwa (Hindu New Year)
observances.description: New Year in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana (Ugadi) and Maharashtra and Goa (Gudi Padwa).
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Rama Navami
observances.description: The birthday of Rama, celebrated at midday.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midday in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Akshaya Tritiya
observances.description: A day held to be lasting (akshaya) in its good effects: for buying gold, starting things, giving.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Narasimha Jayanti
observances.description: The appearance of Narasimha, the man-lion form of Vishnu, at dusk.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the early evening in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Hariyali Teej
observances.description: Women's festival of the monsoon: swings, green clothes, fasting for husbands' welfare.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Krishna Janmashtami
observances.timing: Shravana Kṛṣṇa Aṣṭamī (amānta); Bhadrapada in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: Krishna's birthday, kept with a fast until midnight.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midnight in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Nandotsava
observances.timing: Shravana Kṛṣṇa Navamī (amānta); Bhadrapada in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: The day after Janmashtami: Nanda's celebration of Krishna's birth.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midnight in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Hartalika Teej
observances.description: Teej one lunar month after Hariyali Teej, the day before Ganesh Chaturthi; a women's fast.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
observances.description: Ganesha's festival, with his image installed at home or in public; the main puja is at midday.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midday in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Radhashtami
observances.description: Radha's birthday, kept especially in the Braj region.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midday in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Ananta Chaturdashi
observances.description: Worship of Vishnu as Ananta; the last day of the Ganesh festival, when images are immersed.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Maha Navami (Navaratri)
observances.description: The ninth night of the autumn Navaratri.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Vijayadashami (Dussehra)
observances.description: The victory of Rama over Ravana and of Durga over Mahishasura.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the afternoon in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Karva Chauth
observances.timing: Ashvin Kṛṣṇa Caturthī (amānta); Kartika in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: Married women fast from sunrise until the Moon rises.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the early evening in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Govatsa Dvadashi
observances.timing: Ashvin Kṛṣṇa Dvādaśī (amānta); Kartika in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: Cows and calves are honoured; in Maharashtra the first day of Diwali.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the early evening in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Naraka Chaturdashi
observances.timing: Ashvin Kṛṣṇa Caturdaśī (amānta); Kartika in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: Krishna's defeat of the demon Naraka; an oil bath before sunrise.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Diwali (Lakshmi Puja)
observances.timing: Ashvin Amāvasyā (amānta); Kartika in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: The main night of Diwali, the festival of lights: worship of Lakshmi in the evening.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the early evening in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Govardhan Puja and Bali Pratipada
observances.description: The day after Diwali: Krishna lifting Govardhan hill; Bali's return.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Bhai Dooj
observances.description: Sisters honour their brothers; the last day of Diwali.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the afternoon in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Chhath
observances.description: The main day of Chhath, the festival of the Sun, with offerings at sunset and the next sunrise (Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern Uttar Pradesh, Nepal).
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Vivaha Panchami
observances.description: The wedding of Rama and Sita.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Kurma Dvadashi
observances.description: Kept for Kurma, the tortoise form of Vishnu.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Ganesh Jayanti
observances.description: Ganesha's birthday in the Magha tradition (Maharashtra, Goa).
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midday in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Vasant Panchami
observances.description: The start of spring and worship of Saraswati, goddess of learning; yellow clothes.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Ratha Saptami
observances.description: For the Sun god Surya: the Sun's chariot turning north.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Maha Shivaratri
observances.timing: Magha Kṛṣṇa Caturdaśī (amānta); Phalguna in the pūrṇimānta reckoning
observances.description: The great night of Shiva, kept with a fast and a night-long vigil.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midnight in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Holika Dahana
observances.description: The bonfire for the burning of Holika, on the full-Moon evening, the night before Holi. Wikipedia's Holika Dahana article gives the day before (Phalguna Śukla Caturdaśī); we follow the full-Moon evening that the Holi article and almanacs use.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force in the early evening in Ujjain, the rule almanacs use for this festival. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.
